sources.snippet: CLASSER is a framework for cross-lingual annotation projection with script-similarity-based refinement to create high-quality fine-grained named entity recognition datasets. Utilizing CLASSER, fine-grained named entity recognition dataset is created in five languages: Assamese (as), Bodo (brx), Marathi (mr), Nepali (ne) and Sanskrit (as).
